name: Priya Sharma
bio:
Priya's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While pursuing her engineering degree, a volunteer opportunity at a local rally event ignited a passion she never knew she had. She was captivated by the intricate machinery and the relentless pursuit of perfection. Her career started in automotive manufacturing, where she honed her skills in precision engineering and defect detection. 

Driven by a desire to contribute directly to racing performance, Priya transitioned to motorsport, focusing on quality control. She believes that meticulous attention to detail is paramount, ensuring every component meets stringent standards. Her calm demeanor allows her to thrive under pressure, methodically identifying and resolving issues that could impact performance. Priya is known for her ability to quickly grasp complex systems and her unwavering commitment to delivering flawless results.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided, often tied back in a neat bun
physical.description: Priya is of average height with a slender build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when concentrating.
Insists on double-checking every measurement, even if others assure her it's correct.
